name: GeoGuessr
short: GeoGuessr-style location guessing game using Google Street View.
description: A multiplayer GeoGuessr-style game for Discord. Posts a Google Street View image and players race to guess the location. Features distance-based scoring (up to 5,000 pts), a 90-second timer, per-round multiplayer results, and an all-time server leaderboard.
author: UltPanda
install_msg:
Set your API keys first:
`[p]geoset streetview_key <key>`
`[p]geoset maps_key <key>`

Get keys at https://console.cloud.google.com — enable **Street View Static API** and **Geocoding API**.
